steps.description: The current page is about:blank with no interactive elements. To start the workflow, we need to load the OKX Web3 homepage. Therefore, the next action is to navigate to the provided URL.
The user wants to click the '行情' link located at the top left of the Web3 homepage. The current screen shows an element with ID hexa-2 representing this link. Clicking it is the next required step.

We have navigated to the token list page (行情). The next goal step is to open the first token's detail page. In the current screen, the first token link is the <a> element with text "Punch" and ID hexa-43. Clicking this will load the token's detail page where we can later check the risk acknowledgement box and start trading.

We are on the token detail page after clicking the first coin (Punch). The next step in the user goal is to check the '我已知晓交易风险' box before starting the trade. The label for this checkbox is present as hexa-148, so we click it to toggle the checkbox.

The user wants to finish by clicking the '开始交易' button after acknowledging the risk. The current screen shows a button with text '开始交易' having id hexa-149. The prior steps have already checked the risk box, so the next step is to click this button.
